description.value: King George Donair is an authentic Middle Eastern restaurant serving donairs, slow-cooked lamb shank, crispy falafel, kebabs, and rice plates at two BC locations, including this New Westminster spot. The restaurant occupies a former Freshii location on 6th Ave and emphasizes traditional recipes and fresh ingredients. It offers indoor seating and online ordering for pickup or delivery, making it a convenient full-meal stop for hungry cyclists passing through New Westminster.
